Human hair grows at an average rate of about **1 centimeter (0.4 inches) per month** , though speed varies depending on genetics, health, and hair thickness.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_hair_growth)

### The Hair Growth Cycle

Hair goes through four distinct phases:[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9917549/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_hair_growth)

- **Anagen (Growth Phase):** Lasts 3 to 5 years; about 85% to 90% of your scalp hair is in this phase at any given time.
- **Catagen (Transitional Phase):** Lasts about 2 weeks as the hair follicle shrinks.
- **Telogen (Resting Phase):** Lasts about 3 months before the hair naturally sheds.
- **Exogen (Shedding Phase):** Normal daily shedding ranges from **50 to 100 hairs per day**.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9917549/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_hair_growth)



---

### What Actually Works for Hair Growth

- **Topical Minoxidil:** Widely recognized as the best-supported over-the-counter treatment with regulatory approval for pattern hair loss (available in 2% or 5% formulas).[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[2]](https://health.yahoo.com/your-body/hair-loss/article/the-5-hair-growth-products-that-arent-actually-worth-your-money-142236130.html)
- **Prescription Medications:** Treatments like **finasteride** (oral DHT blocker for men), **spironolactone** (for women), or **dutasteride** can target hormonal hair loss.[[1]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)
- **Targeted Supplements:** Fixing confirmed nutritional deficiencies (such as iron, zinc, or vitamin D) helps, though blanket multivitamins or biotin provide little benefit if you are not deficient.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/what-makes-hair-grow)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[3]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)
- **Scalp Care & Massage:** Daily 4-minute scalp massages or microneedling can help stimulate local blood circulation to the follicles.[[1]](https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-and-treatments/hair-loss/ss/slideshow-ways-to-help-hair-grow-faster-stronger)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9917549/)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/what-makes-hair-grow)



---

### Healthy Habits to Support Growth

- **Diet:** Eat at least **50 grams of protein daily** alongside iron-rich greens (like spinach), eggs, nuts, and omega-3 fatty acids.
- **Heat & Chemical Limits:** Reduce tight hairstyles (like high-tension extensions or tight ponytails), minimize heat styling, and use heat protectants.
- **Protection:** Sleep on a silk or satin pillowcase to reduce friction and breakage on strands.[[1]](https://www.kerastase-usa.com/discover/9-hair-growth-tips.html)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/what-makes-hair-grow)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v3fPBcjYKaY)[[4]](https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-and-treatments/hair-loss/ss/slideshow-ways-to-help-hair-grow-faster-stronger)
